title: Software Engineering Intern
eligibility: Students currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or a related technical field.
qualification: Proficiency in one or more general-purpose programming languages (C++, Java, Python, Go).
description: Work on core technology products, solve complex technical problems, and gain hands-on software development experience alongside Google engineers.

title: Rhodes Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Undergraduate students and recent graduates aged 18 to 24 with exceptional academic achievement and leadership potential.
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, living stipend, travel expenses)
qualification: Bachelor's degree with high academic standing.
description: Fully funded postgraduate award enabling exceptional young people from around the world to study at the University of Oxford.

title: Junior Frontend Engineer (React)
eligibility: Open to entry-level to mid-level web developers globally.
qualification: Strong skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern React frameworks.
description: Build clean, responsive user interfaces for Canonical web applications, desktop sites, and developer documentation tools.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of experience.
qualification: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
description: Drive product innovation, define technical requirements, design user experiences, and collaborate with cross-functional development teams.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university.
salary: $100,000 USD Grand Prize + Azure Credits & Mentorship
qualification: Student tech innovation project utilizing AI and Microsoft Azure cloud services.
description: Global technology competition encouraging students to build innovative tech solutions tackling world challenges using AI.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with no prior programming experience required.
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking and problem-solving using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
